summary: FINAL verification E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) with speed_test@t.com/test123. ALL 8 previously-reported blocking bugs from iteration_3 are FIXED. Discover card renders beautifully (~5s first load) showing Aisha Patel 29, Toronto Canada, 90% match, Marketer + Full Time chips, skills pills (Growth Marketing/SEO/Content/Meta Ads), and a rich AI-generated compatibility explanation. All 5 tabs navigate correctly (/discover, /matches, /assistant, /projects, /profile) with blur tab bar and gold active state. Swipe left (X) worked: Aisha Patel -> Elena Rossi. Swipe right (heart) worked: card animated away and next card appeared. AI Copilot shows welcome + 4 prompt cards; tapping a prompt yields a placeholder response (MOCKED as documented in review request). Projects tab shows the SaaS Platform project card with hours/equity/skills chips and a FAB '+'. Profile tab shows hero image, Level 1 badge, name (Speed Test), Developer + NYC + Full Time meta, stats grid (Level/Projects/Startups), Verification 0/5 list with Email/LinkedIn/GitHub/Portfolio, and (on scroll) Premium CTA and Log out. Matches tab shows a well-designed empty state ('No matches yet' + 'Start discovering' CTA). Chat flow could not be exercised E2E because 3 consecutive right-swipes did not produce a mutual match (expected: the seeded profiles have not liked speed_test back), but match-modal + chat/[matchId] code paths look correct and have proper testIDs. Non-blocking console warnings remain: shadow* / pointerEvents deprecated (RN-web).

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt version-detection warning still present in backend logs — not blocking auth.

integration_issues.issue: Could not force a mutual match with speed_test@t.com by liking 3 seeded profiles in a row — the seeded founders don't 'like' back automatically, so match-modal + navigate-to-chat path is not exercised E2E in this run. Consider seeding a pre-existing match for speed_test@t.com so this path is testable, OR making one of the seeded founder profiles auto-like new users. Match modal code + testID='match-modal' + testID='match-chat-button' look correct.

issues: Console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking on web, but should be migrated for RN 0.75+.

props.pointerEvents on TouchableOpacity/Pressable is deprecated. Move to style.pointerEvents.

critical_code_review_comments: discover.tsx now uses useWindowDimensions and clamps CARD_WIDTH/HEIGHT — layout is stable across viewports. Good fix.
Error state with retry button (discover-retry testID) is now present — differentiates API failure from empty deck. Good fix.
AI Copilot response is a hardcoded setTimeout placeholder — this is MOCKED per the review request and needs to be wired to the actual backend streaming endpoint before shipping.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all 5 tabs, discover card render, swipe actions, prompt-click flow verified. Only match modal + chat send flow not exercised due to no mutual match available.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used the existing speed_test@t.com / test123 account. Verified that the 8 seeded founder profiles (Aisha Patel, Elena Rossi, etc.) are visible in the Discover deck.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All previously-blocking issues from iteration_3 (backend 30s -> 5s, discover card layout, projects tab icon, user identifier collision, error state) are FIXED and verified. Only remaining unverified surface is match-modal + chat send after a mutual like, which requires either (a) seeding a mutual match for speed_test@t.com or (b) creating a second test user, having them both like each other, then logging in as one. Correct testIDs confirmed: discover-screen, discover-card, discover-like-button, discover-pass-button, discover-retry, discover-reload, discover-empty, match-modal, match-chat-button, match-keep-swiping. Tab bar uses role='tab' with names 'Discover'/'Matches'/'AI Copilot'/'Projects'/'Profile' — prefer page.get_by_role('tab', name='X') over get_by_text (which collides with in-page headings). AI Copilot has 4 prompt cards responding with a placeholder (MOCKED).

Prior discovery-cards 502 was fixed by parallelizing per-card AI compatibility calls with asyncio.gather + compatibility_cache in MongoDB (first call ~5s, cached <1s), and the card layout was fixed with useWindowDimensions + clamped CARD_WIDTH/CARD_HEIGHT + a fixed cardWrapper container.
